newsitem.title: USA: OfficeMax to open 95-100 stores this year.
newsitem.headline: OfficeMax to open 95-100 stores this year.

text.p: OfficeMax Inc said it will accelerate its store expansion plans for the balance of fiscal 1996 by opening a total of 95 to 100 superstores as well as dramatically increasing next year's openings.
It said it plans to open about 125 to 150 stores next year, up from the previously announced plan of 80 for both years.

"We see a unique and very significant window of opportunity created by the consolidation from three major chains down to two currently taking place in the office products superstore industry," stated chairman and chief executive Michael Feuer.
"During the next 24 months, OfficeMax plans to use a preemptive store opening strategy to gain major market share throughout the United States," he said.
Feuer also said that the company will continue to expand its existing network of delivery centers by adding an unspecified number of new facilities over the next two years.

He said OfficeMax also has ambitious plans to enter the international market. Last week, OfficeMax opened its first joint venture superstore in Mexico City, where it plans to open about three added stores by the end of this fiscal year and up to 50 over the next three to five years.
